steps.name: Classificar
steps.task: Say which protocol of the skill applies: A (quote analysis), B (condo mediation) or C (daily charging).

steps.name: Analisar
steps.task: Work the case with the facts of the skill. Cite the law article or DGEG guide behind each legal claim and show every number computed. When a legal claim is made, give the link of each law or guide cited (for example on diariodarepublica.pt or dgeg.gov.pt); with no legal claim, hand back an empty list. Never give a link you did not open.

steps.name: Redigir
steps.task: Write the answer or the letter to the condo administration, firm and polite, in PT-PT.

steps.name: Verificar
steps.task: Recompute every number and re-read every citation against the source. List what was checked.
